event-mapping: the WndProc reduces WM_CLOSE / WM_SIZE / WM_PAINT / WM_LBUTTONDOWN to RawMessage; events::translate maps it to WindowEvent; degenerate messages (zero client size, negative client click) are filtered; Closed/Clicked align with the ui@1 closed/click variants (RFC-0052 §2)
determinism: same message stream => same delivered event sequence => same digest; the frozen value is recomputed in every process, so two separate processes agree exactly
evidence-class: internal-fixture / runtime-verified window-shell event pump (not a guest-level or pilot-level feature claim)
digest: sha256 over the fixed versioned wire form of the delivered event sequence
limits: title-bytes: 256 (checked before UTF-16 encoding / any window allocation)
queue-events: 256 (pre-allocated; a push beyond the cap coalesces by kind where lossless, otherwise reports the overflow; never a silent drop)
real-window-smoke: opt-in (#[ignore]); passed on the evidence host: create_window -> offscreen render -> present -> read-back byte-identical -> close -> Closed event delivered -> should_quit -> idempotent destroy
